decisions.reason: As the flagship product line with high sunk investment, public launch, and centrality to the firm's direction, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal very unlikely despite any disappointing results.
Although less central than the flagship, the institute builds on established offerings and has received public commitment, so management remains inclined to justify and persist with it.
With only a website mention, low visibility, and limited centrality, this support tool has weak escalation pressures, so it is the most likely to be dropped to release resources for core initiatives.
The analytics dashboard builds on the established offer, was presented on its own page, and aligns with the announced digital-connected direction, so moderate commitment supports keeping it.
As a complete practice bundle close to the core offer and given prominent presentation, it benefits from high centrality and visible commitment, making discontinuation unlikely.
Because the listing portal is distant from the established offer, had only a website mention, and lacks centrality or public commitment, escalation of commitment is weak and dropping is likely.
